facts.fact: FAO's WaPOR Phase 2 project, in partnership with Egypt's Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, produced a 10 m Sentinel-2 crop type map of Mallawi, Minya for 2023-2024, published 2026-06-24.
